messages.content:
Read one passage of a document about machines at work (law, manual, guidance, internal guideline,
plant record) and write down the important facts it states.

Answer with one line per fact, fields separated by " | ", nothing else, no header, no code fence:
subject | predicate | object | condition | quote
- predicate: a short camelCase verb phrase of your choice.
- condition: any condition or exception, or "" if none.
- quote: the words of the passage the fact comes from.
At most 12 facts. If the passage states nothing important, answer with the single word NONE.

Passage: REG, Art. 38(3)

Article 38 Operational obligations of notified bodies. 3. Where a notified body finds that the essential health and safety requirements set out in Annex III, or corresponding harmonised standards or common specifications referred to in Article 20 have not been met by a manufacturer, it shall require the manufacturer to take appropriate corrective actions and shall not issue an EU-type examination certificate, adopt a quality system approval decision or issue a unit verification certificate.

response.text:
notified body | shall require | manufacturer to take appropriate corrective actions | where it finds Annex III essential health and safety requirements, or corresponding harmonised standards or common specifications under Article 20, not met by the manufacturer | "it shall require the manufacturer to take appropriate corrective actions"
notified body | shall not issue | EU-type examination certificate | where it finds Annex III essential health and safety requirements, or corresponding harmonised standards or common specifications under Article 20, not met by the manufacturer | "shall not issue an EU-type examination certificate"
notified body | shall not adopt | quality system approval decision | where it finds Annex III essential health and safety requirements, or corresponding harmonised standards or common specifications under Article 20, not met by the manufacturer | "adopt a quality system approval decision"
notified body | shall not issue | unit verification certificate | where it finds Annex III essential health and safety requirements, or corresponding harmonised standards or common specifications under Article 20, not met by the manufacturer | "issue a unit verification certificate"
essential health and safety requirements | are set out in | Annex III | "" | "essential health and safety requirements set out in Annex III"
